subject: general
question: The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Bill, 2019 was introduced in Rajya Sabha by the Minister of Home Affairs, Mr. Amit Shah. When did this act of Parliament receive the assent of the President?
solution:
The correct answer is __**August 09, 2019**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Bill, 2019 received the assent of the President on **August 09, 2019**.
 
• This act of Parliament reorganized the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two Union Territories: Jammu and Kashmir, and Ladakh.
